items.question: How many months of loan and bill payment history does a credit report issued by the Al Etihad Credit Bureau (AECB) in the UAE include?
items.gold: Payment history is a record of loan and bill payments for the last 36 months.
items.fact: AECB credit report payment history covers last 36 months

items.question: Which documents must a company present at an Al Ansari Exchange branch when applying for a company credit report from the Al Etihad Credit Bureau in the UAE?
items.gold: The Emirates ID of any partner, shareholder or manager listed in the company trade licence application, and a copy of the trade licence.
items.fact: Company credit report requires Emirates IDs and trade licence copy
